entries.source_evidence: Exact player instruction at Day279 ~10:00 FIRST staffed freight inspection lay-by east of Day278 camp: "What’s going on? Ask both". V chooses to walk over and question both adult civilian forewoman Elen Turr and Veyran logistics Sergeant Adren Vos about their public argument; he does not yet offer arbitration, accept dangerous work, demand sealed records, choose sides, spend resources or promise compensation. By approximately10:05, ELEN freely describes her six iron stretcher-frame fittings as privately paid civilian convalescent-home supplies, produces/holds her signed work order/receipt and protests that the classified delay costs her and her customer; her two loaders remain by her cart. VOS answers with his own perspective without deception proof: official inventory instructions cover military transport equipment/empty sealed cases, and he insists on verifying category before releasing cargo for fear of personal accountability; he does NOT claim the six civilian fittings are individually named on his legal military requisition. When Cirren independently asks whether Vos's sheet expressly lists Elen's fittings or the civilian yard entry merely groups them with the cases, Vos acknowledges the latter is what needs checking; he points toward the civilian yard checker. This dialogue is an independently professional disagreement, not evidence of any specific corrupt intent, proof of authority to impound Elen's civilian property or permission to seize/detain V. Sella independently goes toward the civilian inventory checker in office, where two numbered registers lie open, but has NOT yet brought a confirmed reconciliation/serial-number result to V; actual document comparison, any correction/release, private military itinerary, service or secret site lead remain unplayed. Two ordinary logistics guards at gate and two cargo loaders remain in ordinary peaceful positions, no attack, threat or force. V/Cirren accompany conversation and see the clerks/registers by sight, neither performs Investigation, Insight, Persuasion nor special spell check; no check necessary to hear each participant's freely offered public account. All party stats/resources, personal money and owned gear unchanged; Day279 morning food/feed already deducted to18 ration-person-days/24 horse-feed-days; V purse969gp3sp6cp. V HP48/48 HD7/7, Cirren51/51 HD6/6 full slots, Fenar59/59 HD6/6 Rage4/4 Shift3/3 MP6/6, Mara healthy, own four horses/coach intact, Pixie Dust qty1 unopened. LongRest3/6; it remains Day279 ~10:05 and daytime d10090 already occurred with no random event, no next roll/overnight. V's next decision unresolved: seek actual numbered invoice comparison through independent clerk, ask further questions, or leave with caravan. This is a small ongoing dialogue, not an actual sync boundary; no sync_trigger.
